title: Live: Trump's envoys head to Ukraine after 'substantive' talks with Putin
summary: American envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner discussed "substantive plans" for next steps to end the war in Ukraine during their meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow, the White House said, before they headed to Kyiv on Sunday. Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov said the three-hour talks had been "highly useful" but gave no indication that a breakthrough had been reached. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

title: Chinese military university urged to revise AI course to ‘educate for war’
summary:

title: Taiwan remains Asia’s ‘most dangerous’ issue, former Singaporean diplomat warns
summary:
Asia is still shackled by “mental colonisation” despite accounting for over half the global population, a former UN Security Council president has said, while warning that Taiwan remains the region’s most dangerous flashpoint.
